It sounds like you are carrying an overwhelming amount of stress right now, and it is completely understandable that you are feeling distressed. Please know that you are not a "freak." Hair pulling, especially during times of intense anxiety, is actually a recognized behavior that many people experience as a way to cope with overwhelming feelings. It is not a sign that you are losing your mind, but rather a signal that your stress levels have reached a point where you might need some extra support. 

It is absolutely not too much to hope to feel like yourself again. Because this behavior can be difficult to stop on your own, reaching out to a school counselor, doctor, or mental health professional could be incredibly helpful. They can work with you to find gentle, effective ways to manage your stress and reduce the urge to pull. You do not have to navigate this alone, and there is a lot of hope for finding relief.
